nearest.title: you-one / you-all — say whether “you” addresses one recipient or the whole group
they-one / they-many — say whether ‘they’ is one actor or several
some-or-all / some-but-not-all — does ‘some’ leave room for all?
nearest.distinction: subset quantification over a bounded population, not exactly-one

nearest.title: each-alone / as-one — distributive vs collective: does the plural act once, or once each?
nearest.distinction: distribution of an already plural action set, not membership count

nearest.title: whole(<S>) / part(<S>) — declare whether a reported set is the complete population or a subset
nearest.distinction: reported-set completeness, not a prospective role constraint

nearest.title: among-others / and-no-others — is the list the whole list?
nearest.distinction: enumeration closure, not a participant-count constraint

nearest.title: no-delegation / one-hop-delegation-allowed — state whether a task may be handed to another principal
nearest.distinction: handoff depth, not the number of principals satisfying a role

nearest.title: or-both / not-both — English 'or' never says whether both is allowed
nearest.distinction: choice-set conjunction, not existential versus exact-one cardinality
